hints.title: Count Spaces and Extract Words
hints.text: Count total space characters and extract all non-empty word tokens from the input text.

hints.title: Calculate Gap and Remainder
hints.text: Divide spaces by word count minus one to get equal spacing between words.

hints.title: Handle Single Word Edge Case
hints.text: If there is only one word, join with no gap and put all spaces at the very end.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def reorderSpaces(self, text: str) -> str:
        total_spaces = text.count(" ")
        words = text.split()
        n = len(words)
        if n == 1:
            return words[0] + " " * total_spaces
        gap = total_spaces // (n - 1)
        rem = total_spaces % (n - 1)
        return (" " * gap).join(words) + " " * rem
```
